吃力.zh: 这种吃力不讨好的差事，大家都不愿意接。
吃力.en: Nobody wants to take on a thankless, exhausting job like this.

参谋.zh: 婚礼的场地还没定，你能给我当个参谋吗？
参谋.en: We haven't settled on a wedding venue yet. Could you be my adviser?

勾结.zh: 调查发现，这名员工与外人勾结，偷偷泄露了客户信息。
勾结.en: The investigation found that this employee colluded with outsiders and secretly leaked customer information.

动荡.zh: 经历了一段动荡不安的日子后，他终于在小城安定下来。
动荡.en: After a period of unsettled, turbulent days, he finally settled down in a small town.

充沛.zh: 这个地区雨量充沛，非常适合种植水稻。
充沛.en: This region has abundant rainfall and is ideal for growing rice.

会晤.zh: 两国外长在日内瓦举行会晤，就气候合作交换了意见。
会晤.en: The two foreign ministers met in Geneva and exchanged views on climate cooperation.

亚军.zh: 决赛中他只慢了零点一秒，遗憾地获得了亚军。
亚军.en: In the final he was only a tenth of a second slower and had to settle for second place.

主权.zh: 根据国际法，任何国家都不能侵犯别国的领土主权。
主权.en: Under international law, no country may violate another country's territorial sovereignty.

主办.zh: 本届音乐节由市文化局主办，共持续三天。
主办.en: This year's music festival is hosted by the city's culture bureau and lasts three days.

眯.zh: 他笑起来的时候，眼睛总是眯成一条缝。
眯.en: When he laughs, his eyes always narrow into slits.

盛行.zh: 早在唐代，饮茶之风就已经十分盛行。
盛行.en: As early as the Tang dynasty, tea drinking was already very popular.

畅通.zh: 请保持消防通道畅通，不要在这里停车。
畅通.en: Please keep the fire lane clear and do not park here.

生疏.zh: 我刚搬到这里，人地生疏，连买菜的地方都找不到。
生疏.en: I've just moved here and know neither the place nor the people; I can't even find where to buy groceries.

海拔.zh: 由于海拔太高，很多游客一到拉萨就出现了高原反应。
海拔.en: Because the altitude is so high, many tourists get altitude sickness as soon as they arrive in Lhasa.

斯文.zh: 别看他平时很斯文，打起篮球来可一点儿也不客气。
斯文.en: He may seem gentle and refined most of the time, but on the basketball court he shows no mercy.

悬挂.zh: 节日期间，街道两旁悬挂着五颜六色的彩旗。
悬挂.en: During the festival, colourful flags hang along both sides of the street.

堆积.zh: 秋天到了，院子里堆积了厚厚一层落叶。
堆积.en: Autumn has come, and a thick layer of fallen leaves has piled up in the yard.

坚韧.zh: 竹子质地坚韧，常被用来制作各种家具。
坚韧.en: Bamboo is tough and durable, so it is often used to make all kinds of furniture.

唾弃.zh: 这种背叛朋友的行为，必然会遭到大家的唾弃。
唾弃.en: Betraying a friend like that is bound to be despised by everyone.

觉悟.zh: 在佛教里，“佛”的意思就是觉悟了的人。
觉悟.en: In Buddhism, 'Buddha' means one who has become enlightened.

自发.zh: 演出结束后，观众们自发起立，鼓掌了好几分钟。
自发.en: After the performance, the audience spontaneously stood up and applauded for several minutes.

空隙.zh: 两辆车之间的空隙太小，我的车根本停不进去。
空隙.en: The gap between the two cars is too small; I simply can't park in it.

狠心.zh: 看着孩子哭着要糖，妈妈还是狠心拒绝了他。
狠心.en: Although the child was crying for sweets, his mother hardened her heart and said no.

派别.zh: 这两个学术派别在这个问题上的观点完全相反。
派别.en: These two schools of thought hold completely opposite views on this issue.

攻克.zh: 为了攻克英语口语这一关，他每天早上都对着镜子练习。
攻克.en: To conquer the hurdle of spoken English, he practises in front of the mirror every morning.

意向.zh: 这家公司对我们的产品表现出了很强的购买意向。
意向.en: This company has shown a strong intention to buy our products.

开拓.zh: 公司需要一批敢于开拓进取的年轻人。
开拓.en: The company needs young people who dare to break new ground and push forward.

别致.zh: 她送我的生日贺卡设计得很别致，我一直舍不得扔。
别致.en: The birthday card she gave me had such a distinctive design that I've never been able to throw it away.

创业.zh: 很多年轻人辞掉稳定的工作，回到家乡创业。
创业.en: Many young people quit stable jobs and go back to their hometowns to start businesses.

伤脑筋.zh: 每到周末不知道吃什么，真是件伤脑筋的事。
伤脑筋.en: Not knowing what to eat every weekend is a real headache.

为期.zh: 学校组织了一次为期五天的夏令营。
为期.en: The school organised a summer camp lasting five days.

通货膨胀.zh: 由于通货膨胀，同样一百块钱现在能买的东西比以前少多了。
通货膨胀.en: Because of inflation, the same hundred yuan buys much less now than it used to.

端正.zh: 这孩子写的字端正整齐，一看就很认真。
端正.en: This child's handwriting is neat and upright; you can tell at a glance how careful he is.

港湾.zh: 这个小渔村坐落在一个风平浪静的港湾里。
港湾.en: This small fishing village sits in a calm, sheltered bay.

文献.zh: 图书馆保存着大量珍贵的历史文献。
文献.en: The library holds a large number of valuable historical documents.

崇敬.zh: 人们怀着崇敬的心情参观了这位科学家的故居。
崇敬.en: People visited the scientist's former home with feelings of deep reverence.

对照.zh: 做完练习后，你可以对照书后的答案自己检查。
对照.en: After finishing the exercises, you can check your work against the answers at the back of the book.

媒介.zh: 蚊子是传播很多疾病的媒介。
媒介.en: Mosquitoes are carriers of many diseases.

处分.zh: 他上班时间多次喝酒，公司决定给予他记过处分。
处分.en: He drank on the job several times, so the company decided to give him a formal demerit.

和气.zh: 老人常说和气生财，所以他对每位顾客都笑脸相迎。
和气.en: Old people often say friendliness brings wealth, so he greets every customer with a smile.

霸道.zh: 这家公司的条款太霸道了，消费者根本没有选择。
霸道.en: This company's terms are too high-handed; consumers have no choice at all.

赞叹.zh: 看了她的书法作品，大家都忍不住连声赞叹。
赞叹.en: After seeing her calligraphy, everyone couldn't help exclaiming in admiration.

苦涩.zh: 这种野菜吃起来有点儿苦涩，但对身体很好。
苦涩.en: This wild vegetable tastes a bit bitter and astringent, but it's very good for you.

耸.zh: 市中心，一座座摩天大楼高耸入云。
耸.en: In the city centre, skyscraper after skyscraper soars into the clouds.

科目.zh: 驾照考试一共有四个科目，他已经通过了三个。
科目.en: The driving test has four parts in total, and he has already passed three.

点缀.zh: 蓝蓝的天空中点缀着几朵白云。
点缀.en: A few white clouds dot the deep blue sky.

歌颂.zh: 这部电影歌颂了普通人在平凡岗位上的奉献精神。
歌颂.en: This film celebrates the dedication of ordinary people in ordinary jobs.

杂交.zh: 这种狗是用两个不同的品种杂交出来的。
杂交.en: This kind of dog was bred by crossing two different breeds.

暂且.zh: 别的暂且不说，光是房租就花掉了我一半的工资。
暂且.en: Never mind everything else: the rent alone eats up half my salary.

嘱咐.zh: 医生再三嘱咐他按时吃药，不要喝酒。
嘱咐.en: The doctor told him again and again to take his medicine on time and not to drink.

冷落.zh: 新来的同事不太爱说话，大家可别冷落了她。
冷落.en: The new colleague doesn't talk much, so don't leave her out in the cold.

一丝不苟.zh: 这位工程师对每个零件都检查得一丝不苟。
一丝不苟.en: This engineer inspects every single part meticulously.

迟缓.zh: 老人行动迟缓，过马路时需要有人搀扶。
迟缓.en: The old man moves slowly and needs someone to help him across the road.

眼色.zh: 开会时，同事悄悄朝我递了个眼色，示意老板进来了。
眼色.en: During the meeting a colleague quietly shot me a look to signal that the boss had come in.

浸泡.zh: 新买的衣服最好先用冷水浸泡半小时再洗。
浸泡.en: It's best to soak new clothes in cold water for half an hour before washing them.

栏目.zh: 这家报纸新开设了一个读者来信栏目。
栏目.en: This newspaper has launched a new readers' letters column.

有条不紊.zh: 虽然客人很多，服务员们依然有条不紊地上菜。
有条不紊.en: Even though there were many guests, the waiters kept serving dishes in an orderly way.

慰问.zh: 炎炎夏日，志愿者们带着绿豆汤到工地慰问工人。
慰问.en: In the scorching summer, volunteers brought mung-bean soup to the building site for the workers.

威信.zh: 新来的经理处事公正，很快就在员工中树立了威信。
威信.en: The new manager is fair-minded and quickly established his authority among the staff.

一目了然.zh: 这张地图标得很清楚，各个景点的位置一目了然。
一目了然.en: This map is clearly marked; the location of every sight is obvious at a glance.

自力更生.zh: 父母去世后，她靠打工自力更生，读完了大学。
自力更生.en: After her parents died, she supported herself with part-time jobs and finished university.

灯笼.zh: 元宵节晚上，孩子们提着灯笼在街上猜谜语。
灯笼.en: On the evening of the Lantern Festival, children carry lanterns in the street and guess riddles.

时事.zh: 面试时，考官问了我几个关于时事的问题。
时事.en: During the interview, the examiner asked me a few questions about current affairs.

新颖.zh: 这位作家的写作角度很新颖，读者们都很喜欢。
新颖.en: This writer's angle is very original, and readers love it.

兴高采烈.zh: 听说下周要去海边旅行，全家人都兴高采烈的。
兴高采烈.en: Hearing they were going to the seaside next week, the whole family was in high spirits.

停泊.zh: 这艘大型游轮将在青岛港停泊两天。
停泊.en: This large cruise ship will be berthed in Qingdao port for two days.

倔强.zh: 摔倒了好几次，这个倔强的小女孩还是咬着牙自己站了起来。
倔强.en: Though she fell several times, the determined little girl gritted her teeth and got up by herself.

俯视.zh: 坐在飞机上俯视大地，河流就像一条条细线。
俯视.en: Looking down at the land from a plane, the rivers look like thin threads.

世代.zh: 这个村子的人世代以种茶为生。
世代.en: The people of this village have grown tea for a living for generations.

靠拢.zh: 天快黑了，羊群慢慢向牧羊人靠拢。
靠拢.en: As darkness fell, the flock slowly drew closer to the shepherd.

踏实.zh: 考试前准备充分，心里就踏实多了。
踏实.en: When you've prepared well before an exam, you feel much more at ease.

立足.zh: 这家小公司凭借优质服务，很快在本地市场立足。
立足.en: With excellent service, this small company quickly gained a foothold in the local market.

物业.zh: 小区的物业管理很好，到处都干干净净的。
物业.en: The property management in this housing estate is very good; everywhere is spotless.

淡水.zh: 这种鱼只能生活在淡水里，不能放进海水中。
淡水.en: This kind of fish can only live in fresh water; it can't be put into seawater.

杠杆.zh: 他用一根木棍当杠杆，把大石头撬了起来。
杠杆.en: He used a wooden stick as a lever and prised the big rock up.

朴素.zh: 老一辈人艰苦朴素的作风值得我们学习。
朴素.en: The older generation's hard-working, frugal ways are worth learning from.

开辟.zh: 学校在操场旁边开辟了一块菜地，让学生种菜。
开辟.en: The school opened up a vegetable plot next to the playground for students to grow vegetables.

家喻户晓.zh: 这首歌一夜之间火遍全国，成了家喻户晓的名曲。
家喻户晓.en: This song became a nationwide hit overnight and turned into a tune known in every household.

周折.zh: 为了找到这本绝版书，他费了不少周折。
周折.en: He went through a lot of trouble to find this out-of-print book.

丛.zh: 草丛里突然跳出一只小兔子。
丛.en: A little rabbit suddenly hopped out of the grass.

进而.zh: 他先学会了做饭，进而开了一家自己的小餐馆。
进而.en: He first learned to cook, and then went a step further and opened his own little restaurant.

请示.zh: 这么大的开支我无权决定，必须请示上级。
请示.en: I have no authority to approve such a large expense; I must ask my superiors for instructions.

肆无忌惮.zh: 这些游客在景区里肆无忌惮地乱扔垃圾。
肆无忌惮.en: These tourists brazenly litter all over the scenic area.

确立.zh: 这次会议确立了公司未来五年的发展方向。
确立.en: This meeting established the company's direction of development for the next five years.

盛情.zh: 主人盛情邀请我们留下来吃晚饭。
盛情.en: Our host warmly insisted that we stay for dinner.

狼吞虎咽.zh: 吃饭要细嚼慢咽，狼吞虎咽对胃不好。
狼吞虎咽.en: You should chew your food slowly; wolfing it down is bad for your stomach.

框架.zh: 这座房子的钢筋框架已经搭好了。
框架.en: The steel frame of this house has already been put up.

平坦.zh: 过了这座山，前面就是一片平坦的草原。
平坦.en: Beyond this mountain lies a stretch of flat grassland.

冰雹.zh: 天气预报说今天下午可能会下冰雹，出门要小心。
冰雹.en: The forecast says there may be hail this afternoon, so be careful when you go out.

随即.zh: 老师宣布下课，教室里随即热闹起来。
随即.en: The teacher announced the end of class, and the classroom immediately came alive.

赤字.zh: 由于支出远远大于收入，这个城市的预算出现了巨额赤字。
赤字.en: Because spending far exceeded income, the city's budget ran a huge deficit.

草案.zh: 这份城市规划草案将向社会公开征求意见。
草案.en: This draft urban plan will be opened to the public for comments.

精简.zh: 这篇报告太长了，请你精简一下，控制在两页以内。
精简.en: This report is too long. Please cut it down to two pages or fewer.

疙瘩.zh: 通过这次谈话，他终于解开了心里的疙瘩。
疙瘩.en: Through this conversation, he finally untied the knot in his heart.

时而.zh: 她一个人坐在窗前，时而望着远方发呆。
时而.en: She sat alone by the window, now and then staring blankly into the distance.

散文.zh: 这本杂志主要刊登散文和诗歌。
散文.en: This magazine mainly publishes essays and poetry.

工艺品.zh: 游客们在市场上买了不少民族工艺品作纪念。
工艺品.en: The tourists bought quite a few ethnic handicrafts at the market as souvenirs.

埋没.zh: 要是没有那位老师的发现，她的绘画天赋可能就被埋没了。
埋没.en: If that teacher hadn't noticed her, her talent for painting might have gone to waste.

品德.zh: 学校不仅要教知识，还要培养学生良好的品德。
品德.en: Schools should not only teach knowledge but also cultivate good moral character in students.

偏差.zh: 项目一开始方向就出现了偏差，后来花了很大力气才纠正过来。
偏差.en: The project went off course right from the start, and it took a lot of effort to put it right.

倘若.zh: 倘若你遇到什么困难，随时可以来找我。
倘若.en: If you run into any difficulty, you can come to me any time.

便于.zh: 为了便于管理，图书馆把书按类别分开摆放。
便于.en: To make management easier, the library shelves books separately by category.

雄伟.zh: 远远望去，这座古老的宫殿显得格外雄伟。
雄伟.en: Seen from afar, this ancient palace looks especially majestic.

通俗.zh: 这位老师讲课通俗易懂，学生们都爱听。
通俗.en: This teacher explains things in a way that's easy to understand, and the students love listening.

装卸.zh: 这台机器每小时能装卸五十个集装箱。
装卸.en: This machine can load and unload fifty containers an hour.

衬托.zh: 这条红围巾把她的脸衬托得更白了。
衬托.en: This red scarf sets off her face and makes it look even fairer.

考核.zh: 公司每年年底都会对员工的工作表现进行考核。
考核.en: At the end of every year, the company assesses its employees' performance.

繁华.zh: 这里二十年前还是一片农田，如今已经变得十分繁华。
繁华.en: Twenty years ago this was farmland; today it has become a bustling place.

母语.zh: 学习外语时，很多人习惯先在心里用母语翻译一遍。
母语.en: When learning a foreign language, many people habitually translate into their mother tongue in their heads first.

以至.zh: 这部电影太感人了，以至很多观众都流下了眼泪。
以至.en: The film was so moving that many viewers were brought to tears.

举足轻重.zh: 外语能力在找工作时起着举足轻重的作用。
举足轻重.en: Foreign-language ability plays a pivotal role when looking for a job.

隐约.zh: 雾很大，只能隐约看到远处的山。
隐约.en: The fog is thick; you can only faintly make out the mountains in the distance.

调和.zh: 把蓝色和黄色调和在一起，就变成了绿色。
调和.en: Mix blue and yellow together and you get green.

误差.zh: 这块手表每天的误差不超过一秒。
误差.en: This watch is accurate to within one second a day.

论证.zh: 这篇论文论证严密，数据充分，得到了评审专家的一致好评。
论证.en: The paper's reasoning is rigorous and its data ample, and the reviewers praised it unanimously.

灌溉.zh: 这条水渠修好后，几千亩土地都能得到灌溉。
灌溉.en: Once this canal is finished, thousands of mu of land can be irrigated.

注释.zh: 遇到看不懂的古诗，可以先看看下面的注释。
注释.en: When you come across an ancient poem you don't understand, look at the notes below first.

油腻.zh: 这道菜太油腻了，我吃了几口就吃不下了。
油腻.en: This dish is too greasy; after a few bites I couldn't eat any more.

摘要.zh: 开会前，秘书把报告的摘要发给了每位经理。
摘要.en: Before the meeting, the secretary sent a summary of the report to every manager.

姑且.zh: 他说的话不一定可信，我们姑且听听吧。
姑且.en: What he says may not be reliable, but let's hear him out for now.

天文.zh: 这座城市新建了一座天文馆，周末很多孩子去参观。
天文.en: The city has built a new planetarium, and many children visit it at weekends.

大体.zh: 她很识大体，从不为小事和别人计较。
大体.en: She sees the bigger picture and never squabbles with others over trifles.

变故.zh: 这对夫妻本来打算出国，后来因为一场变故取消了计划。
变故.en: The couple had planned to go abroad but cancelled their plans after an unexpected turn of events.

发扬.zh: 年轻一代应该继承和发扬传统文化中的优秀部分。
发扬.en: The younger generation should inherit and carry forward the best parts of traditional culture.

反问.zh: 面对记者的提问，他没有直接回答，而是反问了一句。
反问.en: Faced with the reporter's question, he didn't answer directly but asked a question back.

争气.zh: 这次比赛又输了，他觉得自己太不争气了。
争气.en: He lost the competition again and felt he had really let everyone down.

不相上下.zh: 他和哥哥的身高不相上下，都一米八左右。
不相上下.en: He and his older brother are about the same height, both around 1.8 metres.

问世.zh: 自从电脑问世以来，人们的工作方式发生了巨大变化。
问世.en: Since the computer came into being, the way people work has changed enormously.

锦上添花.zh: 这家酒店本来就很漂亮，门前的花园更是锦上添花。
锦上添花.en: This hotel was already beautiful, and the garden in front is the icing on the cake.

钻研.zh: 她刻苦钻研业务，很快成了部门的技术骨干。
钻研.en: She studied her field diligently and soon became a technical mainstay of the department.

追悼.zh: 这位老作家去世后，文学界为他举行了隆重的追悼大会。
追悼.en: After the veteran writer died, the literary world held a solemn memorial service for him.

萌芽.zh: 很多矛盾如果在萌芽状态就处理好，就不会越闹越大。
萌芽.en: Many conflicts, if dealt with while still in the bud, won't grow bigger and bigger.

立方.zh: 这个月我们家用了十二立方米的水，比上个月多了不少。
立方.en: Our household used twelve cubic metres of water this month, quite a bit more than last month.

波涛.zh: 船在波涛中上下摇晃，不少乘客都晕船了。
波涛.en: The ship pitched up and down in the great waves, and many passengers got seasick.

播种.zh: 爷爷说现在还太冷，等过了清明再播种。
播种.en: Grandpa says it's still too cold now; we'll sow after Qingming.

寒暄.zh: 见面时不必寒暄太久，直接说明来意就行。
寒暄.en: There's no need for long pleasantries when you meet; just state your purpose.

千方百计.zh: 为了让顾客满意，这家餐厅千方百计地提高服务质量。
千方百计.en: To keep customers happy, this restaurant does everything possible to improve its service.

加剧.zh: 长时间熬夜会加剧头痛的症状。
加剧.en: Staying up late for long periods will make headache symptoms worse.

伶俐.zh: 她口齿伶俐，说起话来又快又清楚。
伶俐.en: She is very articulate; she speaks quickly and clearly.

书法.zh: 这家博物馆正在展出王羲之的书法作品。
书法.en: This museum is currently exhibiting calligraphy by Wang Xizhi.

上进.zh: 这孩子很有上进心，每次考试都想超过上一次。
上进.en: This child is very driven and always wants to beat his last exam score.

陈列.zh: 商店的橱窗里陈列着各种新款手表。
陈列.en: All kinds of new watches are displayed in the shop window.

镶嵌.zh: 这座老房子的窗户上镶嵌着彩色玻璃。
镶嵌.en: The windows of this old house are set with coloured glass.

赤道.zh: 飞机飞越赤道的时候，机长特意通知了乘客。
赤道.en: When the plane crossed the equator, the captain made a point of telling the passengers.

胸怀.zh: 他从小胸怀大志，一心想成为一名科学家。
胸怀.en: Since childhood he has cherished great ambitions and set his heart on becoming a scientist.

无穷无尽.zh: 宇宙是无穷无尽的，人类的探索永远不会停止。
无穷无尽.en: The universe is boundless, and humanity's exploration will never stop.

拄.zh: 登山的时候，他拄着一根木棍，走得轻松多了。
拄.en: When climbing the mountain, he leaned on a wooden stick and found it much easier going.

心疼.zh: 这件新外套刚穿一天就弄破了，我心疼得不得了。
心疼.en: I tore this new coat after wearing it for only one day, and it really pains me.

巴结.zh: 他从来不巴结有钱人，对谁都一样客气。
巴结.en: He never sucks up to rich people; he's equally polite to everyone.

力求.zh: 这篇翻译力求准确，每个词都反复查过词典。
力求.en: This translation strives for accuracy; every word was checked in the dictionary again and again.

不屑一顾.zh: 有些人对传统手艺不屑一顾，觉得它早就过时了。
不屑一顾.en: Some people scorn traditional crafts, thinking they are long out of date.

遏制.zh: 为了遏制疾病的传播，学校暂时停课了。
遏制.en: To curb the spread of the disease, the school temporarily suspended classes.

督促.zh: 手机上的提醒功能会督促我每天喝够八杯水。
督促.en: The reminder function on my phone pushes me to drink eight glasses of water every day.

着重.zh: 这次培训着重提高员工的沟通能力。
着重.en: This training focuses on improving employees' communication skills.

盖章.zh: 合同双方都签字盖章以后才算正式生效。
盖章.en: The contract only takes effect once both parties have signed and stamped it.

湖泊.zh: 由于气候变暖，这一地区不少湖泊的面积正在缩小。
湖泊.en: Because of climate warming, many lakes in this region are shrinking.

椭圆.zh: 地球绕太阳运行的轨道是一个椭圆。
椭圆.en: The orbit of the earth around the sun is an ellipse.

操劳.zh: 王医生日夜操劳，终于累倒在了工作岗位上。
操劳.en: Dr Wang toiled day and night until he finally collapsed from exhaustion at work.

心得.zh: 读完这本书后，老师让我们每人写一篇读书心得。
心得.en: After we finished the book, the teacher had each of us write about what we had learned from it.

刊物.zh: 这是一本面向中学生的科普刊物，每月出版一期。
刊物.en: This is a popular-science periodical for secondary-school students, published once a month.

颈椎.zh: 长期伏案工作的人容易得颈椎病。
颈椎.en: People who work bent over a desk for long periods are prone to neck (cervical spine) problems.

迎面.zh: 我刚走进餐厅，就迎面碰上了老同学。
迎面.en: As soon as I walked into the restaurant, I ran right into an old classmate.

舒畅.zh: 呼吸着山里的新鲜空气，大家都觉得浑身舒畅。
舒畅.en: Breathing the fresh mountain air, everyone felt relaxed from head to toe.

章程.zh: 按照公司章程，董事会每年至少要开两次会议。
章程.en: According to the company's articles, the board must meet at least twice a year.

神气.zh: 他得了冠军以后，走起路来都神气多了。
神气.en: After he won the championship, he even walked with a lot more swagger.

栽培.zh: 这种花对温度要求很高，栽培起来比较困难。
栽培.en: This flower is very demanding about temperature and is rather difficult to grow.

昼夜.zh: 这里的昼夜温差很大，晚上要多穿点衣服。
昼夜.en: The temperature difference between day and night is big here, so wear more at night.

敌视.zh: 我们不应该因为文化不同就敌视别人。
敌视.en: We shouldn't be hostile to others just because their culture is different.

招收.zh: 这个舞蹈班只招收五岁以上的儿童。
招收.en: This dance class only takes children aged five and over.

吹捧.zh: 这本书被一些网站吹捧得很厉害，其实写得很一般。
吹捧.en: This book has been hyped up by some websites, but it's actually quite ordinary.

名次.zh: 这次考试他的名次比上次前进了十名。
名次.en: In this exam he moved up ten places compared with last time.

倡导.zh: 作为环保理念的积极倡导者，她从不使用一次性餐具。
倡导.en: As an active advocate of environmental protection, she never uses disposable tableware.

不言而喻.zh: 这次失败的原因不言而喻，就是准备不足。
不言而喻.en: The reason for this failure goes without saying: insufficient preparation.

诧异.zh: 看到平时总迟到的他今天第一个到，老师感到很诧异。
诧异.en: Seeing him, usually always late, arrive first today, the teacher was astonished.

渔民.zh: 每天清晨，渔民们都会驾着小船出海捕鱼。
渔民.en: Every morning at dawn, the fishermen sail out to sea in their small boats.

托运.zh: 我们搬家时，把家具交给物流公司托运。
托运.en: When we moved house, we had a logistics company ship our furniture.

成心.zh: 他明知道我怕狗，还成心把狗带到我家来。
成心.en: He knew perfectly well I'm afraid of dogs, yet he deliberately brought his dog to my home.

忌讳.zh: 他很忌讳别人问他的年龄。
忌讳.en: He really dislikes it when people ask his age.

导向.zh: 家长的态度对孩子的价值观有很强的导向作用。
导向.en: Parents' attitudes play a strong guiding role in shaping children's values.

啰唆.zh: 妈妈每天都啰唆个没完，提醒我多穿衣服。
啰唆.en: Mum nags endlessly every day, reminding me to wear more clothes.

变迁.zh: 爷爷经常给我们讲这几十年来家乡的变迁。
变迁.en: Grandpa often tells us about the changes in our hometown over the past few decades.

制约.zh: 天气条件往往制约着农作物的产量。
制约.en: Weather conditions often limit crop yields.

列举.zh: 老师在课上列举了很多生活中的例子。
列举.en: In class the teacher cited many examples from everyday life.

公证.zh: 这份遗嘱已经经过公证，任何人都无权更改。
公证.en: This will has been notarised, so no one has the right to alter it.

佳肴.zh: 这位厨师能把普通的豆腐做成一道道佳肴。
佳肴.en: This chef can turn ordinary tofu into one fine dish after another.

亏待.zh: 她把公婆当亲生父母照顾，从来没有亏待过他们。
亏待.en: She cares for her parents-in-law like her own parents and has never treated them shabbily.

魄力.zh: 要做出这么大的改变，需要很大的魄力。
魄力.en: Making such a big change takes a great deal of boldness.

顿时.zh: 灯一灭，屋子里顿时一片漆黑。
顿时.en: The moment the lights went out, the room was plunged into darkness.

鞭策.zh: 失败对他来说不是打击，而是一种鞭策。
鞭策.en: For him, failure is not a blow but a spur.

索性.zh: 等了半个小时公交车还没来，我索性走回家了。
索性.en: After waiting half an hour and the bus still not coming, I just walked home.

相声.zh: 春节晚会上的这段相声把全场观众都逗笑了。
相声.en: This crosstalk act at the Spring Festival Gala made the whole audience laugh.

涌现.zh: 最近几年，市场上涌现出各种各样的新能源汽车。
涌现.en: In recent years, all kinds of new-energy vehicles have flooded onto the market.

朴实.zh: 他的演讲朴实无华，却句句打动人心。
朴实.en: His speech was plain and unadorned, yet every sentence touched people's hearts.

固然.zh: 这家店的东西固然便宜，可质量实在太差了。
固然.en: This shop's goods are admittedly cheap, but the quality is really poor.

呼啸.zh: 一辆救护车呼啸着从我们身边开过。
呼啸.en: An ambulance went screaming past us.

吉祥.zh: 龙在中国文化中象征着吉祥。
吉祥.en: In Chinese culture, the dragon symbolises good fortune.

讥笑.zh: 他第一次上台唱歌就跑调了，却没有一个人讥笑他。
讥笑.en: The first time he sang on stage he went off key, yet not a single person ridiculed him.

蔚蓝.zh: 站在船头，眼前是一片蔚蓝的大海。
蔚蓝.en: Standing at the bow, I saw a stretch of azure sea before me.

茎.zh: 把花插进花瓶之前，最好把茎剪短一点。
茎.en: Before putting flowers in a vase, it's best to trim the stems a little.

答辩.zh: 答辩时，老师们向他提了很多尖锐的问题。
答辩.en: During his oral defence, the professors asked him many pointed questions.

慈祥.zh: 那位老医生说话温和，看起来非常慈祥。
慈祥.en: That old doctor speaks gently and looks very kindly.

家常.zh: 两位老朋友坐在院子里喝茶，聊着家常。
家常.en: The two old friends sat in the courtyard drinking tea and chatting about everyday family matters.

学说.zh: 达尔文提出的进化学说改变了人们对生命起源的认识。
学说.en: The theory of evolution put forward by Darwin changed people's understanding of the origin of life.

壮丽.zh: 站在山顶，我们看到了壮丽的云海。
壮丽.en: Standing on the summit, we saw a magnificent sea of clouds.

周转.zh: 这家小超市靠朋友借的钱才勉强周转过来。
周转.en: This small supermarket only just kept its cash flowing thanks to money borrowed from friends.

兴旺.zh: 这个家族人丁兴旺，过年时有五十多人一起吃饭。
兴旺.en: This family is large and thriving; over fifty people eat together at New Year.

借鉴.zh: 这篇文章的写法很值得大家借鉴。
借鉴.en: The way this article is written is well worth learning from.

飘扬.zh: 学校门口的旗子在风中高高飘扬。
飘扬.en: The flag at the school gate flutters high in the wind.

纺织.zh: 这家纺织厂生产的毛巾远销国外。
纺织.en: The towels made by this textile mill are sold far abroad.

纵横.zh: 他在商界纵横几十年，经验非常丰富。
纵横.en: He has moved freely through the business world for decades and has a wealth of experience.

旷课.zh: 如果一学期旷课超过十次，就不能参加期末考试。
旷课.en: If you skip class more than ten times in a semester, you can't sit the final exam.

文艺.zh: 她从小就喜欢文艺，唱歌跳舞样样都会。
文艺.en: She has loved the arts since childhood and can both sing and dance.

截至.zh: 截至目前，这部电影的票房已经突破十亿元。
截至.en: As of now, this film's box office has passed one billion yuan.

威望.zh: 这位老科学家在国际学术界享有崇高的威望。
威望.en: This veteran scientist enjoys great prestige in the international academic community.

夹杂.zh: 风里夹杂着一股烤红薯的香味。
夹杂.en: The wind carried a whiff of roasted sweet potatoes.

壮烈.zh: 这位消防员在一次救火中壮烈牺牲了。
壮烈.en: This firefighter died a hero's death while fighting a fire.

反之.zh: 坚持锻炼的人身体会越来越好，反之，身体就会变差。
反之.en: People who keep exercising get healthier and healthier; conversely, those who don't get weaker.

历来.zh: 这所学校历来以严格的管理著称。
历来.en: This school has always been known for its strict management.

分寸.zh: 他说话很有分寸，从不让人难堪。
分寸.en: He speaks with great tact and never embarrasses anyone.

起哄.zh: 看到新郎脸红了，客人们都跟着起哄。
起哄.en: Seeing the groom blush, the guests all joined in teasing him.

贯彻.zh: 我们要把节约用水的原则贯彻到生活的每个方面。
贯彻.en: We should put the principle of saving water into practice in every aspect of life.

蕴藏.zh: 每个孩子身上都蕴藏着巨大的潜力。
蕴藏.en: Every child holds enormous latent potential.

相等.zh: 这个三角形的三条边长度都相等。
相等.en: All three sides of this triangle are equal in length.

畔.zh: 我小时候常常在河畔放风筝。
畔.en: When I was little I often flew kites on the riverbank.

沿海.zh: 每年夏天，沿海地区都会受到台风的影响。
沿海.en: Every summer, coastal areas are affected by typhoons.

污蔑.zh: 他在网上发帖污蔑这家餐厅卖过期食品，结果被起诉了。
污蔑.en: He posted online slandering the restaurant for selling expired food and ended up being sued.

棍棒.zh: 过去有人认为棍棒底下出孝子，现在这种观念已经过时了。
棍棒.en: People used to say that a filial child is raised under the rod, but that idea is now outdated.

梢.zh: 她的发梢有点干，需要剪一剪了。
梢.en: The ends of her hair are a bit dry and need trimming.

操练.zh: 老师让我们反复操练这几个句型。
操练.en: The teacher had us drill these sentence patterns over and over.

搀.zh: 护士搀着刚做完手术的病人在走廊里散步。
搀.en: The nurse supported the patient, just out of surgery, by the arm as they walked in the corridor.

拟定.zh: 律师帮我们拟定了一份详细的租房合同。
拟定.en: The lawyer helped us draw up a detailed tenancy agreement.

悬殊.zh: 这两家公司的规模悬殊，根本没法比。
悬殊.en: The two companies differ hugely in size; there's simply no comparison.

恭敬.zh: 他恭敬地双手接过了老人递来的名片。
恭敬.en: He respectfully took the business card from the old man with both hands.

归根到底.zh: 孩子的问题，归根到底是家庭教育的问题。
归根到底.en: Children's problems are, in the final analysis, problems of upbringing at home.

寓言.zh: 《龟兔赛跑》是一个很有名的寓言故事。
寓言.en: "The Tortoise and the Hare" is a very famous fable.

多元化.zh: 这家公司正在走多元化的发展道路，不再只卖手机。
多元化.en: This company is pursuing diversified development and no longer sells only phones.

喧哗.zh: 门外一阵喧哗，原来是邻居家在办喜事。
喧哗.en: There was a commotion outside; it turned out the neighbours were holding a wedding celebration.

哺乳.zh: 母猫正在给刚出生的小猫哺乳。
哺乳.en: The mother cat is nursing her newborn kittens.

启蒙.zh: 这本儿童读物是很多人的科学启蒙书。
启蒙.en: This children's book was many people's first introduction to science.

俗话.zh: 俗话说，一分钱一分货，太便宜的东西别买。
俗话.en: As the saying goes, you get what you pay for, so don't buy things that are too cheap.

逆行.zh: 一名骑电动车的男子逆行，差点撞上了公交车。
逆行.en: A man on an e-bike was riding the wrong way and nearly hit a bus.

贬义.zh: 在不同的语境中，同一个词可能有褒义，也可能有贬义。
贬义.en: In different contexts, the same word may have a positive or a negative connotation.

落成.zh: 这座跨江大桥落成以后，两岸往来方便多了。
落成.en: Since this bridge across the river was completed, travel between the two banks has become much easier.

留念.zh: 演出结束后，歌迷们排队请她签名留念。
留念.en: After the show, fans queued up to get her autograph as a keepsake.

斟酌.zh: 这封信我斟酌了很久，才决定怎么写开头。
斟酌.en: I deliberated over this letter for a long time before deciding how to begin it.

挑拨.zh: 她总在两个朋友之间挑拨是非，大家渐渐疏远了她。
挑拨.en: She was always stirring up trouble between her two friends, and people gradually distanced themselves from her.

承包.zh: 他承包了村里的几十亩果园，收入很不错。
承包.en: He contracted dozens of mu of the village's orchards and earns a good income.

批发.zh: 这家小店的饮料都是从厂家直接批发来的。
批发.en: All the drinks in this little shop are bought wholesale directly from the manufacturer.

扎实.zh: 这位厨师刀工扎实，切出来的土豆丝又细又匀。
扎实.en: This chef has solid knife skills; his shredded potatoes are fine and even.

固有.zh: 每种语言都有自己固有的特点。
固有.en: Every language has its own inherent characteristics.

亏损.zh: 由于经营不善，这家书店去年亏损了二十多万元。
亏损.en: Due to poor management, this bookshop lost over 200,000 yuan last year.

严寒.zh: 为了抵御严寒，北方的房子墙壁都很厚。
严寒.en: To keep out the bitter cold, houses in the north have very thick walls.

饱和.zh: 水里的盐放到一定量就饱和了，再放也溶解不了。
饱和.en: Once enough salt is added, the water becomes saturated and any more won't dissolve.

陡峭.zh: 这面悬崖十分陡峭，只有经验丰富的攀岩者才敢挑战。
陡峭.en: This cliff is extremely steep; only experienced climbers dare to take it on.

谢绝.zh: 本店谢绝自带酒水，请大家谅解。
谢绝.en: This restaurant does not allow outside drinks; thank you for your understanding.

自满.zh: 他考了第一名以后有些骄傲自满，学习不如以前认真了。
自满.en: After coming first he grew a bit complacent and doesn't study as seriously as before.

涂抹.zh: 他在面包上涂抹了一层厚厚的果酱。
涂抹.en: He spread a thick layer of jam on the bread.

法人.zh: 这家分公司不是独立法人，不能单独签订合同。
法人.en: This branch is not an independent legal entity and cannot sign contracts on its own.

次品.zh: 工厂发现这批产品中有不少次品，全部退回重做。
次品.en: The factory found many defective items in this batch and sent them all back to be remade.

地势.zh: 这座城市地势低洼，一下大雨就容易积水。
地势.en: This city is low-lying, so water easily collects whenever it rains heavily.

合算.zh: 这么多人一起去，租一辆车比各自打车合算得多。
合算.en: With this many people going, renting one car is much better value than everyone taking taxis.

力争.zh: 他据理力争，最后说服了在场的所有人。
力争.en: He argued his case firmly on the facts and finally convinced everyone present.

书记.zh: 庭审过程中，书记员要把每个人说的话都准确记录下来。
书记.en: During a trial, the court clerk must accurately record what everyone says.

遮挡.zh: 前面的大树遮挡了视线，我看不清路牌。
遮挡.en: The big tree in front blocked my view, so I couldn't read the road sign.

衣裳.zh: 妈妈把晒干的衣裳叠好放进了柜子。
衣裳.en: Mum folded the sun-dried clothes and put them in the wardrobe.

荤.zh: 这家食堂每天都提供两荤两素的套餐。
荤.en: This canteen offers a set meal of two meat dishes and two vegetable dishes every day.

花蕾.zh: 这盆月季已经长出了好几个花蕾，过几天就要开了。
花蕾.en: This pot of roses already has several buds and will bloom in a few days.

舰艇.zh: 海军的舰艇对市民开放参观，吸引了很多孩子。
舰艇.en: The navy's vessels were opened to the public, attracting many children.

职能.zh: 新成立的部门承担了原来人事处和财务处的职能。
职能.en: The newly formed department has taken over the functions of the former personnel and finance offices.

浓厚.zh: 过年时，街上的节日气氛十分浓厚。
浓厚.en: At New Year, the festive atmosphere on the streets is very strong.

洽谈.zh: 这次展会上，我们和三家外国公司洽谈了业务。
洽谈.en: At this trade fair we held business talks with three foreign companies.

格局.zh: 新商场开业以后，这条街的商业格局发生了很大变化。
格局.en: After the new mall opened, the commercial layout of this street changed a great deal.

根深蒂固.zh: 多年养成的习惯根深蒂固，想改掉可没那么容易。
根深蒂固.en: Habits formed over many years are deeply ingrained and not easy to break.

哆嗦.zh: 他第一次上台演讲，紧张得手直哆嗦。
哆嗦.en: Giving a speech on stage for the first time, he was so nervous his hands kept trembling.

及早.zh: 发现孩子视力下降，家长应及早带他去配眼镜。
及早.en: When parents notice a child's eyesight getting worse, they should get him glasses as early as possible.

剪彩.zh: 新医院开业那天，几位老专家出席了剪彩仪式。
剪彩.en: On the day the new hospital opened, several veteran experts attended the ribbon-cutting ceremony.

辽阔.zh: 我国幅员辽阔，南北气候差异很大。
辽阔.en: Our country covers a vast territory, and the climate differs greatly between north and south.

茂盛.zh: 院子里的杂草长得很茂盛，该除一除了。
茂盛.en: The weeds in the yard have grown very thick; it's time to pull them.

肥沃.zh: 东北的黑土地非常肥沃，出产优质大米。
肥沃.en: The black soil of the northeast is very fertile and produces high-quality rice.

空前绝后.zh: 他的这项纪录几乎是空前绝后的，至今无人打破。
空前绝后.en: His record is practically unique in history; no one has broken it to this day.

检讨.zh: 他在会上作了深刻的检讨，承认是自己的疏忽造成了损失。
检讨.en: At the meeting he made a thorough self-criticism, admitting his carelessness had caused the loss.

无微不至.zh: 妈妈对我的关心无微不至，连我爱吃什么都记得清清楚楚。
无微不至.en: Mum cares for me in every possible way; she even remembers exactly what I like to eat.

挎.zh: 他肩上挎着一个相机，看起来像个游客。
挎.en: He had a camera slung over his shoulder and looked like a tourist.

并列.zh: 这篇文章的两个观点是并列关系，没有主次之分。
并列.en: The two points in this article are parallel, with neither more important than the other.

实惠.zh: 这款手机功能齐全，价格也实惠，很受学生欢迎。
实惠.en: This phone is fully featured and affordable, and it's very popular with students.

势必.zh: 如果大家都开车上班，势必会造成严重的交通堵塞。
势必.en: If everyone drives to work, it is bound to cause serious traffic jams.

再接再厉.zh: 教练告诉队员们，赢了一场不算什么，还要再接再厉。
再接再厉.en: The coach told the players that one win means little and they must keep up the effort.

兴隆.zh: 这家面馆开了二十年，生意一直很兴隆。
兴隆.en: This noodle shop has been open for twenty years, and business has always been booming.

风气.zh: 这个小区邻里互助的风气很浓。
风气.en: There's a strong culture of neighbours helping each other in this community.

零星.zh: 天黑以后，广场上只剩下零星几个游客。
零星.en: After dark, only a scattered few tourists were left in the square.

雄厚.zh: 这所大学师资力量雄厚，吸引了很多优秀学生。
雄厚.en: This university has a strong teaching staff and attracts many outstanding students.

衔接.zh: 地铁站和火车站衔接得很好，换乘只需要五分钟。
衔接.en: The metro station and railway station are well connected; transferring takes only five minutes.

耐用.zh: 这种塑料椅子又轻又耐用，很适合放在户外。
耐用.en: These plastic chairs are light and hard-wearing, ideal for outdoors.

美观.zh: 包装不仅要美观，更要能保护里面的商品。
美观.en: Packaging should not only look good but, more importantly, protect the goods inside.

爱不释手.zh: 爸爸送我的新相机，我拿在手里爱不释手。
爱不释手.en: I love the new camera Dad gave me so much that I can't put it down.

热泪盈眶.zh: 国歌响起时，站在领奖台上的运动员热泪盈眶。
热泪盈眶.en: When the anthem played, the athlete on the podium had eyes brimming with tears.

怠慢.zh: 这位客人很重要，千万不能怠慢。
怠慢.en: This guest is very important; we mustn't neglect him in any way.

志气.zh: 失败了不要灰心，人不能没有志气。
志气.en: Don't lose heart when you fail; a person must never lack backbone.

弊端.zh: 这种方法虽然省事，但弊端也很明显。
弊端.en: Although this method saves effort, its drawbacks are obvious.

吞吞吐吐.zh: 问他昨晚去哪儿了，他吞吞吐吐地说不清楚。
吞吞吐吐.en: When asked where he'd been last night, he hemmed and hawed and couldn't give a clear answer.

兢兢业业.zh: 这位老会计兢兢业业，三十年来账目从没出过错。
兢兢业业.en: This veteran accountant is conscientious and diligent; in thirty years his books have never had an error.

与日俱增.zh: 随着网购越来越方便，快递数量与日俱增。
与日俱增.en: As online shopping becomes more convenient, the number of parcels grows day by day.

附和.zh: 会上经理一说完，几个人就连忙点头附和。
附和.en: As soon as the manager finished speaking at the meeting, several people hurriedly nodded along.

调剂.zh: 他没被第一志愿录取，被调剂到了另一个专业。
调剂.en: He wasn't admitted to his first choice and was reassigned to another major.

见义勇为.zh: 这位年轻人因为见义勇为，跳进河里救起落水儿童，受到了表彰。
见义勇为.en: This young man was honoured for bravely jumping into the river to save a drowning child.

称心如意.zh: 我们逛了一整天，终于买到了一套称心如意的家具。
称心如意.en: We shopped all day and finally bought a set of furniture that was just what we wanted.

神态.zh: 她说话时神态自然，一点儿也不紧张。
神态.en: She looked completely natural when she spoke, not nervous at all.

磨合.zh: 新车开头的几千公里属于磨合期，不要开得太快。
磨合.en: The first few thousand kilometres of a new car are the running-in period, so don't drive too fast.

短促.zh: 听到一阵短促的敲门声，他赶紧去开门。
短促.en: Hearing a few short, quick knocks, he hurried to open the door.

盛产.zh: 这个海边小镇盛产海鲜，价格也便宜。
盛产.en: This seaside town abounds in seafood, and it's cheap too.

气魄.zh: 长城绵延万里，充分显示了中华民族的伟大气魄。
气魄.en: Stretching for thousands of miles, the Great Wall displays the grand spirit of the Chinese nation.

扩充.zh: 这部词典的第二版扩充了五千多个新词条。
扩充.en: The second edition of this dictionary added more than five thousand new entries.

应邀.zh: 这位著名作家应邀来我们学校做讲座。
应邀.en: This famous writer came to our school at our invitation to give a lecture.

屡次.zh: 他屡次向公司提出改进建议，但都没有得到回应。
屡次.en: He repeatedly made suggestions for improvement to the company, but never got a response.

声势.zh: 他只是虚张声势，其实心里根本没底。
声势.en: He's just bluffing; actually he has no confidence at all.

取缔.zh: 这个打着养生旗号骗老人钱的组织已经被依法取缔。
取缔.en: This organisation, which cheated old people under the banner of health care, has been shut down by law.

馋.zh: 这只猫很馋，一不注意就偷吃桌上的鱼。
馋.en: This cat is a glutton; the moment you're not looking it steals the fish off the table.

防治.zh: 春天是花粉过敏的高发季节，要做好防治工作。
防治.en: Spring is peak season for pollen allergies, so prevention and treatment are important.

谋求.zh: 很多年轻人离开家乡，到大城市谋求发展。
谋求.en: Many young people leave their hometowns to seek opportunities in big cities.

落实.zh: 会上定下的措施要尽快落实到每个班级。
落实.en: The measures decided at the meeting must be put into practice in every class as soon as possible.

杜绝.zh: 学校规定考试期间要杜绝一切作弊行为。
杜绝.en: School rules require that all cheating be stamped out during exams.

效益.zh: 这个公益项目虽然不赚钱，但社会效益非常显著。
效益.en: Although this charity project doesn't make money, its social benefits are remarkable.

征收.zh: 这个城市开始对超量的生活垃圾征收处理费。
征收.en: This city has started charging a disposal fee for excess household waste.

化肥.zh: 这些蔬菜种植时没有使用化肥和农药。
化肥.en: These vegetables were grown without chemical fertilisers or pesticides.

勘探.zh: 这支勘探队在沙漠里工作了整整一年。
勘探.en: This survey team worked in the desert for a whole year.

验收.zh: 装修完成后，我们请专业人员来验收。
验收.en: After the renovation was finished, we had professionals come to inspect and sign it off.

聋哑.zh: 他是一名聋哑人，靠手语和别人交流。
聋哑.en: He is deaf and mute and communicates with others in sign language.

缴纳.zh: 车主每年都要按时缴纳车辆保险费。
缴纳.en: Car owners must pay their vehicle insurance premiums on time every year.

繁体字.zh: 这本古书是用繁体字印刷的，我读起来有点儿困难。
繁体字.en: This old book is printed in traditional characters, so it's a bit hard for me to read.

立交桥.zh: 开车经过这座立交桥时，一不小心就会走错出口。
立交桥.en: When driving over this interchange, it's easy to take the wrong exit if you're not careful.

磋商.zh: 这一问题还需要和外方进一步磋商，目前无法给出答复。
磋商.en: This issue needs further consultation with the foreign side, so we can't give an answer yet.

珍稀.zh: 这片森林里生长着许多珍稀植物。
珍稀.en: Many rare plants grow in this forest.

熏陶.zh: 受到艺术氛围的熏陶，这个小镇的孩子大多会画画。
熏陶.en: Shaped by the artistic atmosphere, most children in this town can paint.

水利.zh: 这座水库是当地最重要的水利设施。
水利.en: This reservoir is the most important water-conservancy facility in the area.

普及.zh: 学校应该普及急救知识，让每个学生都学会心肺复苏。
普及.en: Schools should spread first-aid knowledge so that every student learns CPR.

急功近利.zh: 有些家长急功近利，恨不得孩子一夜之间就成为天才。
急功近利.en: Some parents want quick results and wish their children would become geniuses overnight.

循序渐进.zh: 锻炼身体要循序渐进，一开始不要跑太远。
循序渐进.en: Exercise should build up gradually; don't run too far at the start.

层出不穷.zh: 近年来，各种电信诈骗手段层出不穷。
层出不穷.en: In recent years, new kinds of phone scams have kept appearing one after another.

就近.zh: 下雨了，我们就近找了一家咖啡馆躲雨。
就近.en: It started raining, so we ducked into a nearby café to shelter.

实事求是.zh: 评价一个人要实事求是，不能只凭印象。
实事求是.en: When judging a person, you should go by the facts, not just impressions.

完备.zh: 只要手续完备，三天之内就能拿到签证。
完备.en: As long as your paperwork is complete, you can get the visa within three days.

宁肯.zh: 我宁肯走路去，也不愿意在这里排一个小时的队。
宁肯.en: I'd rather walk there than queue here for an hour.

天伦之乐.zh: 春节时一家人团聚在一起，尽享天伦之乐。
天伦之乐.en: At Spring Festival the family gathers together and fully enjoys the happiness of family life.

吃苦.zh: 这份工作又累又脏，不肯吃苦的人是干不下去的。
吃苦.en: This job is tiring and dirty; people unwilling to endure hardship won't last.

儒家.zh: 孔子是儒家学派的创始人。
儒家.en: Confucius was the founder of the Confucian school.

倡议.zh: 环保组织发出倡议，呼吁市民少用塑料袋。
倡议.en: An environmental group issued a proposal urging residents to use fewer plastic bags.

作息.zh: 放假以后，他的作息时间完全乱了。
作息.en: Since the holidays started, his daily routine has been completely thrown off.

争先恐后.zh: 商场一开门，顾客们就争先恐后地冲向打折区。
争先恐后.en: As soon as the mall opened, shoppers scrambled to be first to the sale section.

东张西望.zh: 他站在车站门口东张西望，好像在等什么人。
东张西望.en: He stood at the station entrance looking all around, as if waiting for someone.

骨干.zh: 他在大学时就是学生会的骨干，组织过很多活动。
骨干.en: At university he was a key member of the student union and organised many events.

闭塞.zh: 那时候信息闭塞，村里人过了好几天才知道这个消息。
闭塞.en: Information travelled poorly back then, so it was days before the villagers heard the news.

贫乏.zh: 他的词汇太贫乏了，翻来覆去就那几句话。
贫乏.en: His vocabulary is so limited that he keeps saying the same few things over and over.

耕地.zh: 为了保护耕地，政府不允许在农田上随便盖房子。
耕地.en: To protect farmland, the government doesn't allow houses to be built freely on fields.

矿产.zh: 过度开采矿产会对环境造成严重破坏。
矿产.en: Over-mining mineral resources can cause serious damage to the environment.

瞻仰.zh: 清明节那天，学生们去陵园瞻仰了英雄纪念碑。
瞻仰.en: On Qingming Festival, the students went to the memorial park to pay their respects at the heroes' monument.

盆地.zh: 这座城市位于盆地中间，冬天空气不容易流通。
盆地.en: This city lies in the middle of a basin, so the air doesn't circulate easily in winter.

物美价廉.zh: 这家小餐馆的饭菜物美价廉，中午总是坐满了上班族。
物美价廉.en: This little restaurant's food is good and cheap, so it's always full of office workers at lunchtime.

服气.zh: 他输了比赛还不服气，非要再比一次。
服气.en: He lost the match but wouldn't accept it and insisted on another round.

支流.zh: 这条河有十几条支流，一到雨季水位就涨得很快。
支流.en: This river has a dozen or so tributaries, so its water level rises quickly in the rainy season.

恍然大悟.zh: 看到他手里的蛋糕，我才恍然大悟，原来今天是我的生日。
恍然大悟.en: Seeing the cake in his hands, I suddenly realised that today was my birthday.

审美.zh: 随着生活水平的提高，人们的审美眼光也越来越高。
审美.en: As living standards rise, people's aesthetic standards are getting higher and higher.

奠定.zh: 这部作品奠定了他在文学界的地位。
奠定.en: This work established his position in the literary world.

叮嘱.zh: 临走前，奶奶一再叮嘱我到了学校要给家里打电话。
叮嘱.en: Before I left, Grandma kept reminding me to call home when I got to school.

亭子.zh: 公园的山顶上有一座亭子，可以在里面看风景。
亭子.en: There's a pavilion at the top of the hill in the park where you can enjoy the view.

丘陵.zh: 这条铁路穿过一片丘陵，沿途风景很美。
丘陵.en: This railway runs through hilly country, and the scenery along the way is beautiful.

一举两得.zh: 在网上卖旧书，既能清理房间又能赚点钱，真是一举两得。
一举两得.en: Selling old books online clears out your room and earns some money: two birds with one stone.

见多识广.zh: 导游见多识广，一路上给我们讲了很多有趣的故事。
见多识广.en: The guide was well-travelled and knowledgeable and told us many interesting stories along the way.

稿件.zh: 请在本周五之前把稿件发到编辑的邮箱。
稿件.en: Please send your manuscript to the editor's email by this Friday.

画蛇添足.zh: 他本来已经道歉了，又补充了一大堆理由，真是画蛇添足。
画蛇添足.en: He had already apologised, then added a pile of excuses: completely unnecessary.

沉淀.zh: 茶喝完后，杯底沉淀着一层细细的茶叶末。
沉淀.en: After the tea was drunk, a fine layer of tea dust had settled at the bottom of the cup.

招标.zh: 学校食堂的经营权将通过招标来决定。
招标.en: The right to run the school canteen will be decided through a tender.

娇气.zh: 这种花很娇气，浇水多了少了都会死。
娇气.en: This flower is very delicate; it dies if you water it too much or too little.

园林.zh: 这座古典园林里有假山、池塘和长廊。
园林.en: This classical garden has rockeries, ponds and long covered walkways.

后顾之忧.zh: 有了父母帮忙带孩子，她工作起来就没有后顾之忧了。
后顾之忧.en: With her parents helping with the kids, she can work without worrying about things at home.

刹那.zh: 烟花在夜空中绽放的刹那，人群发出了欢呼。
刹那.en: The instant the fireworks burst in the night sky, the crowd cheered.

兴致勃勃.zh: 爷爷兴致勃勃地给我们讲起了他年轻时的故事。
兴致勃勃.en: Grandpa enthusiastically started telling us stories from his youth.

共计.zh: 本次比赛共计有八百多名选手报名参加。
共计.en: A total of more than eight hundred contestants signed up for this competition.

不由得.zh: 听到这首老歌，他不由得想起了大学时光。
不由得.en: Hearing this old song, he couldn't help thinking of his university days.

不敢当.zh: 大家都叫我专家，我可不敢当，只是多做了几年而已。
不敢当.en: Everyone calls me an expert, but I really don't deserve it; I've just been doing this a few years longer.

霞.zh: 清晨，东方的天空被朝霞染成了金红色。
霞.en: In the early morning, the eastern sky was dyed golden red by the dawn glow.

稠密.zh: 江南地区河网稠密，自古就有“水乡”之称。
稠密.en: Jiangnan is crisscrossed by a dense network of rivers and has long been called 'the land of water'.

砍伐.zh: 由于过度砍伐，这座山上的树越来越少了。
砍伐.en: Because of excessive logging, there are fewer and fewer trees on this mountain.

据悉.zh: 据悉，今年报考研究生的人数又创新高。
据悉.en: It is reported that the number of graduate-school applicants has hit a new record this year.

挺拔.zh: 他身材挺拔，穿上西装特别精神。
挺拔.en: He is tall and upright, and looks especially sharp in a suit.

感慨.zh: 看着孩子一天天长大，父母常常感慨时间过得太快。
感慨.en: Watching their child grow up day by day, parents often sigh at how fast time flies.

封建.zh: 在封建社会，女孩子很少有机会读书。
封建.en: In feudal society, girls rarely had the chance to study.

依托.zh: 这家公司依托互联网平台，把农产品卖到了全国各地。
依托.en: Relying on internet platforms, this company sells farm produce all over the country.

逐年.zh: 由于空气污染，患哮喘的儿童逐年增多。
逐年.en: Because of air pollution, the number of children with asthma rises year by year.

贤惠.zh: 邻居们都夸她是个贤惠的好媳妇。
贤惠.en: The neighbours all praise her as a kind and capable wife.

聚精会神.zh: 司机聚精会神地开着车，一句话也不说。
聚精会神.en: The driver concentrated hard on the road and didn't say a word.

精打细算.zh: 刚工作时工资不高，他每个月都得精打细算。
精打细算.en: When he first started working his salary was low, so he had to budget carefully every month.

欣欣向荣.zh: 这几年小镇的旅游业欣欣向荣，游客越来越多。
欣欣向荣.en: In recent years the town's tourism has flourished, with more and more visitors.

昌盛.zh: 宋代文化昌盛，出现了许多著名的诗人和画家。
昌盛.en: Culture flourished in the Song dynasty, producing many famous poets and painters.

日新月异.zh: 这座城市的面貌日新月异，几年不回来就认不出了。
日新月异.en: This city changes so fast that if you don't come back for a few years you won't recognise it.

把关.zh: 孩子看什么电影，家长要替他们把关。
把关.en: Parents should vet which films their children watch.

得不偿失.zh: 为了赶时间闯红灯，被罚款还扣分，实在得不偿失。
得不偿失.en: Running a red light to save time and then getting fined and penalty points just isn't worth it.

布告.zh: 布告栏上贴着下周停水的通知。
布告.en: A notice about next week's water cut is posted on the bulletin board.

刻不容缓.zh: 病人的情况非常危急，手术已经刻不容缓。
刻不容缓.en: The patient's condition is critical; the operation cannot be delayed a moment longer.

供不应求.zh: 天气一热，冰淇淋和空调就开始供不应求。
供不应求.en: As soon as the weather turns hot, ice cream and air conditioners are in short supply.

炉灶.zh: 这家餐厅的厨房很大，炉灶都是新换的。
炉灶.en: This restaurant's kitchen is big, and all the stoves are new.

比重.zh: 在他的家庭开支中，房租占了很大的比重。
比重.en: Rent makes up a large share of his household spending.

出神.zh: 他的演奏太动人了，台下的观众都听得出神了。
出神.en: His playing was so moving that the audience sat spellbound.

优胜劣汰.zh: 自然界遵循优胜劣汰的法则，适应环境的物种才能生存。
优胜劣汰.en: Nature follows the law of survival of the fittest; only species that adapt can survive.

须知.zh: 入园前请阅读游客须知，不要给动物喂食。
须知.en: Please read the visitor guidelines before entering the park, and don't feed the animals.

边疆.zh: 这首歌描写了边疆地区美丽的风光。
边疆.en: This song describes the beautiful scenery of the border regions.

纲领.zh: 协会成立时，大家共同制定了行动纲领。
纲领.en: When the association was founded, everyone drew up a programme of action together.

正月.zh: 按照老家的习俗，正月里不能理发。
正月.en: According to the custom in my hometown, you're not supposed to get a haircut in the first lunar month.

振兴.zh: 这座老工业城市正在努力振兴旅游业。
振兴.en: This old industrial city is working hard to revitalise its tourism.

废寝忘食.zh: 他迷上了下棋，常常下得废寝忘食。
废寝忘食.en: He became obsessed with chess and often played so long he forgot to eat and sleep.

堤坝.zh: 我们沿着河边的堤坝散步，欣赏落日。
堤坝.en: We walked along the riverside embankment, enjoying the sunset.

凹凸.zh: 这种墙纸表面有凹凸的花纹，摸起来很有质感。
凹凸.en: This wallpaper has a raised pattern and feels richly textured to the touch.

乡镇.zh: 这家医院的医生每个月都会到附近乡镇义诊。
乡镇.en: Doctors from this hospital give free consultations in nearby townships every month.

不免.zh: 离开生活了十年的城市，她心里不免有些难过。
不免.en: Leaving the city she had lived in for ten years, she inevitably felt a bit sad.

难能可贵.zh: 在那么艰苦的条件下坚持学习，真是难能可贵。
难能可贵.en: Keeping up one's studies under such hard conditions is truly commendable.

锲而不舍.zh: 经过十年锲而不舍的研究，他终于找到了答案。
锲而不舍.en: After ten years of unflagging research, he finally found the answer.

辩证.zh: 看问题要有辩证思维，不能只看一面。
辩证.en: You should think dialectically about problems and not look at just one side.

潜移默化.zh: 好书对人的影响是潜移默化的。
潜移默化.en: The influence of good books on people is subtle and gradual.

清真.zh: 这条街上有好几家清真饭馆，牛肉面特别好吃。
清真.en: There are several halal restaurants on this street, and the beef noodles are especially good.

淡季.zh: 冬天是这个海滨城市的旅游淡季，酒店都很空。
淡季.en: Winter is the off season for this seaside city, and the hotels are empty.

气功.zh: 听说练气功能帮助人放松，他也报了个班。
气功.en: He heard that practising qigong helps people relax, so he signed up for a class too.

毅然.zh: 面对家人的反对，她毅然决定去非洲做志愿者。
毅然.en: Despite her family's opposition, she resolutely decided to volunteer in Africa.

正气.zh: 这部电视剧弘扬社会正气，受到了观众的好评。
正气.en: This TV series promotes uprightness in society and has been well received by viewers.

朝代.zh: 历史上每个朝代都有自己独特的服饰风格。
朝代.en: Every dynasty in history had its own distinctive style of dress.

斩钉截铁.zh: 她斩钉截铁地表示，无论多难都不会放弃。
斩钉截铁.en: She declared categorically that she would never give up, however hard it got.

微观.zh: 通过显微镜，我们可以观察到微观世界的奇妙。
微观.en: Through a microscope we can observe the wonders of the microscopic world.

廉洁.zh: 这位法官一生廉洁，从不接受任何人的礼物。
廉洁.en: This judge was incorruptible all his life and never accepted gifts from anyone.

序言.zh: 我习惯先读序言，了解作者写这本书的原因。
序言.en: I usually read the preface first to understand why the author wrote the book.

宏观.zh: 做计划时既要考虑宏观目标，也要注意具体细节。
宏观.en: When making plans, you should consider the big-picture goals as well as the specific details.

历代.zh: 这座寺庙历代都有修缮，至今保存完好。
历代.en: This temple was repaired through successive dynasties and is still well preserved today.

风土人情.zh: 这本游记生动地介绍了云南的风土人情。
风土人情.en: This travelogue vividly introduces the local customs of Yunnan.

豪迈.zh: 登上山顶后，他豪迈地大喊了一声。
豪迈.en: After reaching the summit, he let out a bold, exhilarated shout.

见闻.zh: 爷爷经常跟我们讲他年轻时在国外的见闻。
见闻.en: Grandpa often tells us about what he saw and heard abroad when he was young.

船舶.zh: 这家工厂专门制造大型船舶。
船舶.en: This factory specialises in building large ships.

礼尚往来.zh: 中国人讲究礼尚往来，收到礼物后常常会找机会回礼。
礼尚往来.en: Chinese people value reciprocity; after receiving a gift they often find a chance to give one back.

省会.zh: 很多年轻人毕业后选择留在省会城市工作。
省会.en: Many young people choose to stay and work in the provincial capital after graduating.

查获.zh: 机场安检人员查获了一只藏在行李里的活乌龟。
查获.en: Airport security found and seized a live turtle hidden in someone's luggage.

朝气蓬勃.zh: 新来的老师朝气蓬勃，很快就和学生们打成一片。
朝气蓬勃.en: The new teacher is full of youthful energy and quickly became close with the students.

弊病.zh: 城市化带来了交通拥堵等一系列弊病。
弊病.en: Urbanisation has brought a series of ills such as traffic congestion.

尚且.zh: 这道题老师尚且做不出来，更别说我们了。
尚且.en: Even the teacher couldn't solve this problem, let alone us.

外向.zh: 他看起来很外向，其实私下里很安静。
外向.en: He seems very outgoing, but in private he's actually quiet.

体裁.zh: 这篇作文不限体裁，可以写记叙文，也可以写议论文。
体裁.en: This essay can be in any genre: narrative or argumentative.

任重道远.zh: 要让每个孩子都能上好学校，我们还任重道远。
任重道远.en: We still have a long way to go before every child can attend a good school.

不料.zh: 他以为考试很简单，不料最后一道题一点思路也没有。
不料.en: He thought the exam would be easy, but unexpectedly he had no idea how to do the last question.

鸦雀无声.zh: 校长一走进会议室，大家顿时鸦雀无声。
鸦雀无声.en: As soon as the principal walked into the meeting room, everyone fell completely silent.

过奖.zh: 老板夸我做得好，我连忙说过奖，其实是大家一起完成的。
过奖.en: When the boss praised my work, I quickly said he was too kind; actually we all did it together.

苦尽甘来.zh: 经过多年的努力，这位演员终于苦尽甘来，拿到了最佳女主角奖。
苦尽甘来.en: After years of effort, this actress's hard times finally paid off when she won Best Actress.

精益求精.zh: 这家老字号的厨师做菜精益求精，每道菜都要试好几遍。
精益求精.en: The chefs at this old restaurant keep perfecting their cooking and test every dish several times.

籍贯.zh: 他虽然生在上海，但籍贯是山东。
籍贯.en: Although he was born in Shanghai, his ancestral home is Shandong.

稻谷.zh: 农民们正在晒场上晾晒刚收的稻谷。
稻谷.en: The farmers are drying the freshly harvested rice on the threshing ground.

混浊.zh: 这杯水看起来有点儿混浊，最好别喝。
混浊.en: This glass of water looks a bit cloudy; better not drink it.

悬崖峭壁.zh: 这种山羊能在悬崖峭壁上轻松地跳来跳去。
悬崖峭壁.en: This kind of mountain goat can leap about easily on sheer cliffs.

川流不息.zh: 商场门口的顾客川流不息，生意非常好。
川流不息.en: There is a constant stream of customers at the mall entrance, and business is booming.

压岁钱.zh: 妈妈帮我把压岁钱存进了银行。
压岁钱.en: Mum helped me put my New Year money in the bank.

举世瞩目.zh: 这届奥运会举世瞩目，各国记者都来报道。
举世瞩目.en: These Olympics drew worldwide attention, with reporters from every country covering them.

连年.zh: 由于连年干旱，这里的很多农民都外出打工了。
连年.en: Because of drought year after year, many farmers here have left to find work elsewhere.

诞辰.zh: 今天是孔子诞辰纪念日，曲阜举行了隆重的祭孔大典。
诞辰.en: Today is the anniversary of Confucius's birth, and Qufu held a grand ceremony in his honour.

络绎不绝.zh: 古时候，这条山路上往来的商队络绎不绝。
络绎不绝.en: In ancient times, merchant caravans travelled this mountain road in an endless stream.

知足常乐.zh: 他虽然收入不高，但知足常乐，每天都过得很开心。
知足常乐.en: Although his income isn't high, he's content with what he has and is happy every day.

津津有味.zh: 弟弟吃着妈妈做的红烧肉，吃得津津有味。
津津有味.en: My little brother ate the braised pork Mum made with great relish.

拜年.zh: 现在很多年轻人习惯用视频电话给长辈拜年。
拜年.en: Nowadays many young people wish their elders a happy New Year by video call.

急于求成.zh: 练习书法不能急于求成，每天写一点才能慢慢进步。
急于求成.en: You can't rush calligraphy; only by writing a little every day will you slowly improve.

季军.zh: 冠军和亚军都被别的学校拿走了，我们最后只拿到了季军。
季军.en: Other schools took first and second place; in the end we only got third.

南辕北辙.zh: 我们的方法和目标南辕北辙，难怪越努力离成功越远。
南辕北辙.en: Our methods run directly counter to our goals; no wonder the harder we try, the further we get from success.

公安局.zh: 我的身份证丢了，得去公安局补办一张。
公安局.en: I've lost my ID card and have to go to the public security bureau for a replacement.

乌黑.zh: 这只小猫浑身乌黑，只有四只脚是白的。
乌黑.en: This kitten is jet-black all over except for its four white paws.

馅儿.zh: 这家包子铺的包子皮薄馅儿多，每天早上都排长队。
馅儿.en: This bun shop's buns have thin skins and plenty of filling, and there's a long queue every morning.

联欢.zh: 中秋节那天，留学生们和中国同学一起联欢。
联欢.en: On Mid-Autumn Festival, the international students celebrated together with their Chinese classmates.

相辅相成.zh: 理论和实践是相辅相成的，缺一不可。
相辅相成.en: Theory and practice complement each other; neither can do without the other.

畜牧.zh: 这个地区草场丰富，畜牧业非常发达。
畜牧.en: This region has abundant grassland, and its livestock farming is highly developed.

生肖.zh: 中国有十二生肖，每个人都有自己的属相。
生肖.en: China has twelve zodiac animals, and everyone has their own sign.

理直气壮.zh: 我又没做错事，当然可以理直气壮地说出来。
理直气壮.en: I haven't done anything wrong, so of course I can say it with full confidence.

泰斗.zh: 这位老先生是京剧界的泰斗，很多名演员都是他的学生。
泰斗.en: This old gentleman is a giant of Peking opera, and many famous performers were his students.

沾光.zh: 朋友的公司发展得好，我们这些老同学也沾光不少。
沾光.en: My friend's company is doing well, and we old classmates have benefited a lot from it too.

正负.zh: 两个数相乘时，结果的正负由它们的符号决定。
正负.en: When two numbers are multiplied, whether the result is positive or negative depends on their signs.

旗袍.zh: 这家老店做的旗袍很有名，很多外国游客专门来定做。
旗袍.en: This old shop's qipaos are famous, and many foreign tourists come specially to have one made.

各抒己见.zh: 关于周末去哪儿玩，全家人各抒己见，争了半天也没决定。
各抒己见.en: Everyone in the family had their own idea about where to go at the weekend; they argued for ages without deciding.

勉励.zh: 毕业典礼上，校长勉励大家走上社会后不要忘记初心。
勉励.en: At the graduation ceremony, the principal encouraged everyone not to forget their original aspirations after entering society.

侃侃而谈.zh: 一说起足球，他就侃侃而谈，好像什么都懂。
侃侃而谈.en: As soon as football comes up, he talks on and on with ease, as if he knows everything.

递增.zh: 按照合同，房租每年递增百分之五。
递增.en: Under the contract, the rent increases by five percent each year.

踊跃.zh: 老师讲完以后，同学们踊跃发言，提了很多问题。
踊跃.en: After the teacher finished, the students eagerly spoke up and asked many questions.

羽绒服.zh: 这件羽绒服又轻又暖和，下雪天穿正合适。
羽绒服.en: This down jacket is light and warm, just right for snowy days.

经纬.zh: 织布时，经纬两种线要交错得整整齐齐。
经纬.en: When weaving, the warp and weft threads must cross each other neatly.

纪要.zh: 这份座谈会纪要记录了每位代表的发言。
纪要.en: These minutes of the forum record what each representative said.

炊烟.zh: 远远看到家里的烟囱冒起了炊烟，他知道妈妈在做饭了。
炊烟.en: Seeing cooking smoke rise from the chimney at home in the distance, he knew Mum was making dinner.

温带.zh: 这种植物适合生长在温带地区，热带太热了。
温带.en: This plant grows best in temperate regions; the tropics are too hot.

恳切.zh: 老师语气恳切地劝他不要放弃学业。
恳切.en: The teacher earnestly urged him not to give up his studies.

得天独厚.zh: 这个小岛拥有得天独厚的自然条件，海水清澈见底。
得天独厚.en: This island is blessed with unique natural advantages; the sea is so clear you can see the bottom.

喜闻乐见.zh: 这部动画片用孩子们喜闻乐见的方式讲解了科学知识。
喜闻乐见.en: This cartoon explains science in a way that children love.

博大精深.zh: 中医理论博大精深，学几年也只能懂点皮毛。
博大精深.en: Traditional Chinese medicine is so broad and profound that after a few years of study you only grasp the surface.

勤俭.zh: 奶奶勤俭持家，把一大家子的日子安排得井井有条。
勤俭.en: Grandma runs the household thriftily and keeps the whole big family's life in good order.

农历.zh: 我的生日按农历过，所以每年的日期都不一样。
农历.en: I celebrate my birthday by the lunar calendar, so the date is different every year.

东道主.zh: 这次足球比赛的东道主球队表现得非常出色。
东道主.en: The host team performed outstandingly in this football tournament.

饱经沧桑.zh: 这座饱经沧桑的古城墙已经有六百多年的历史了。
饱经沧桑.en: This weather-beaten ancient city wall is more than six hundred years old.

飞禽走兽.zh: 这位画家擅长画飞禽走兽，尤其是马。
飞禽走兽.en: This painter excels at painting birds and beasts, especially horses.

端午节.zh: 端午节那天，奶奶在门口挂了艾草。
端午节.en: On the Dragon Boat Festival, Grandma hung mugwort by the door.

深情厚谊.zh: 这份礼物虽然不贵，却代表了我们之间的深情厚谊。
深情厚谊.en: This gift isn't expensive, but it stands for the deep friendship between us.

武侠.zh: 他最近迷上了武侠剧，每天晚上都要看两集。
武侠.en: He's recently become hooked on martial-arts dramas and watches two episodes every night.

将就.zh: 家里没有咖啡了，我们将就着喝点茶吧。
将就.en: We're out of coffee at home, so let's make do with some tea.

对联.zh: 爷爷的毛笔字写得好，每年都给邻居写对联。
对联.en: Grandpa has beautiful brush calligraphy and writes couplets for the neighbours every year.

华侨.zh: 这所学校是一位老华侨捐钱建的。
华侨.en: This school was built with money donated by an elderly overseas Chinese.
